title: Hague Convention for the Protection of Cultural Property in the Event of Armed Conflict
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Hague Convention for the Protection of Cultural Property in the Event of Armed Conflict", at revision 1374191348, opens: "The Hague Convention for the Protection of Cultural Property in the Event of Armed Conflict is the first international treaty that focuses exclusively on the protection of cultural property in the event of armed conflict. It was signed at The Hague, Netherlands, on 14 May 1954 and entered into force on 7 August 1956. As of June 2025, it has been ratified by 138 States." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1566342, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "treaty". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
